source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise him in the heights.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the heavens; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the heights!
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Let the heavens praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; let the heights above give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} praise!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Everything in the sky, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Everyone high up in heaven, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis les cieux ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dans les hauteurs !
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Que les cieux louent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; que les hauteurs {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louent !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Vous tous qui êtes dans le ciel, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui êtes là-haut, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka mbinguni; \q msifuni katika mahali palipo juu!
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mbingu na zimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q vilele vya juu na vimpe sifa!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Vyote vilivyo angani, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Ninyi nyote mlio juu mbinguni, msifuni!

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde los cielos; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} en las alturas!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! ¡Que los cielos alaben {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; que las alturas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} den alabanza!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! Todo lo que hay en el cielo, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Todos los que están en lo alto del cielo, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ các tầng trời; \q hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các nơi cao!
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hỡi các tầng trời, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hỡi các nơi cao trên kia, \q hãy dâng lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hỡi mọi vật trên bầu trời, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hỡi tất cả những ai ở trên trời cao, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 하늘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라. \q 높은 곳에서 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 하늘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라. \q 높은 곳들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 하늘에 있는 모든 것아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! \q 하늘 높은 곳에 있는 모든 이들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Aleluia! Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde os céus; louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}} nas alturas!
pt.B: Aleluia! Que os céus louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; que as alturas lá em cima {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deem louvor!
pt.R: Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}! Tudo o que há no céu, louve {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Todos os que estão lá no alto do céu, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!

am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! ሰማይ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ያመስግን፤ \q በላይ ያሉ ከፍታዎችም ያመስግኑት!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ! በሰማይ ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ! \q ከፍ ብላችሁ በሰማይ ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! आकाश में से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो; ऊँचे स्थानों में उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! आकाश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करे; ऊपर के ऊँचे स्थान उनकी स्तुति करें!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो! आकाश में रहनेवाली हर वस्तु, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! ऊपर स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले सब, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} с небес; хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на высотах!
ru.B: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Пусть небеса хвалят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; пусть высоты в вышине воздают {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} хвалу!
ru.R: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}! Всё, что в небе, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Все, кто живёт высоко на небесах, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！天から{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ。もろもろの高い所で、その方を賛美せよ！
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！天よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ。高い所にあるものよ、その方を賛美せよ！
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！空にあるすべてのものよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ！天の高い所にいるすべての者よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} з небес; хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} на висотах!
uk.B: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Нехай небеса хвалять {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; нехай висоти вгорі віддають {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} хвалу!
uk.R: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}! Усе, що на небі, хвали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Усі, хто високо на небесах, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: hallelu-yah, a call to praise the LORD
decisions.reason: The words (hallelu yah) are a command to a group, "praise Yah"; Yah is the short form of the divine name (YHWH). Psalms 146-150 each open and close with this call. Here in Psalm 148 the renderings translate it, as "Praise the LORD", rather than keep it as the borrowed word "Hallelujah".

decisions.choice: from the heavens ... from the earth: all creation
decisions.reason: The psalm calls first on everything in the heavens (verses 1-6) and then on everything on earth (verses 7-14), in much the order of the creation story in Genesis 1: lights, waters, sea creatures, land, plants, animals and people.

decisions.choice: the heights: the highest places, heaven
decisions.reason: The word (meromim) is the heights above, where God's angels are (verse 2; Job 25:2).

decisions.choice: Everything in the sky; Everyone high up in heaven
alternatives: from the heavens; in the heights
decisions.reason: Readable names those who are called on to praise, as verses 2-4 do.

decisions.choice: "Louez-le" with a pronoun setting on "le" for "praise him" throughout Psalms 148 and 150
decisions.reason: French joins the object pronoun to the command with a hyphen. The setting still applies to it, so readers who choose capitals for pronouns of God see "Louez-Le".

decisions.choice: plural_you on every "Alaben" and "Alábenlo" in this psalm
decisions.reason: The psalm calls on heaven and earth and all their creatures with plural commands; Spanish marks each with the plural_you setting. The pronoun joined to the verb ("Alábenlo") takes no deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: Creation is called to praise in the plain imperative, each part named with the vocative "-아/-야"
decisions.reason: A call to all creation, as in a hymn; Korean addresses things and people alike with the plain vocative and imperative, as in Psalm 146.

decisions.choice: Louvem ... louvem-no (L); que ... louvem (B); louve / louvem-no (R)
decisions.reason: The call to praise is plural and goes out to all creation, so it is "Louvem", with "vocês", as everywhere in the book (113:1); "louvem-no" puts the object pronoun after the imperative, as written Brazilian Portuguese does, with the deity_pronoun span on "no". Balanced turns the calls into wishes ("Que os céus louvem") where the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 148.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah translated, "እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ!" (alternative "ያህን አመስግኑ!"), as 146:1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 146 (decision there): the renderings of Psalm 148 translate the call (meaning decision m1), so the Amharic does too, with the short form Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "አመስግኑ" / "አመስግኑት" for every call to praise in the psalm
decisions.reason: Hillel is "አመሰገነ" (terms list); the plural command addresses each group, and "-ት" (him) carries the Hebrew "praise him".

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
decisions.reason: As in 146:1, the call that opens and closes Psalms 146-150 keeps one form at every level.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalm speaks of God with the honorific plural (उनकी, उन्होंने).

decisions.choice: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
decisions.reason: As in 146:1: one wording for hallelu-yah at every level through Psalms 146-150 (m1).

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah, one fixed form through Psalms 146-150: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！" (L, B), "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1, PSA-11): Yah is {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}, the call 〜せよ (L, B), R 〜しよう since God's people are called; the closing Hallel takes the exclamation form used in 111-113 and 135, the same at the head and foot of every psalm.

decisions.choice: Calls to creation "賛美せよ" at R too (148:1-12), while the hallelujah keeps "賛美しよう"
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1): R uses 〜せよ to the nations, the earth and creation, 〜しよう to God's own people; 148:1-12 calls heaven and earth (m2). R supplies who is called as the English R does (r-en-1).

records.literal_gloss: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his hosts.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hosts!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels! All the armies of heaven, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.R: All {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! All the armies of heaven that serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, vous tous, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, vous toutes, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} armées !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, vous tous, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges ! Vous toutes, armées du ciel, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !
fr.R: Vous tous, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Vous toutes, armées du ciel qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servez, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !

sw.L: Msifuni, ninyi malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote; \q msifuni, majeshi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote!
sw.B: Msifuni, enyi malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote! \q Enyi majeshi yote ya mbinguni, msifuni!
sw.R: Malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, msifuni! \q Majeshi yote ya mbinguni yanayomtumikia, msifuni!

es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles! Todos los ejércitos del cielo, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!
es.R: Todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}! Todos los ejércitos del cielo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirven, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi tất cả các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi tất cả các đạo binh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Hỡi tất cả các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hỡi tất cả các đạo quân trên trời, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hỡi tất cả các đạo quân trên trời đang phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 그분의 모든 천사들아, 그분을 찬양하여라. \q 그분의 모든 군대야, 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 그분의 모든 천사들아, 그분을 찬양하여라! \q 하늘의 모든 군대야, 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 그분의 모든 천사들아, 그분을 찬양하여라! \q 그분을 섬기는 하늘의 모든 군대야, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} anjos; louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} exércitos!
pt.B: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} anjos! Todos os exércitos do céu, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!
pt.R: Todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} anjos, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}! Todos os exércitos do céu que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} servem, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!

am.L: አመስግኑት፣ እናንተ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፤ \q አመስግኑት፣ እናንተ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ!
am.B: መላእክቱ ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት! \q የሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!
am.R: መላእክቱ ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት! \q እርሱን የሚያገለግሉ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: हे उनके सब दूतो, उनकी स्तुति करो; हे उनकी सब सेनाओ, उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.B: हे उनके सब स्वर्गदूतो, उनकी स्तुति करो! हे स्वर्ग की सब सेनाओ, उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.R: हे उनके सब स्वर्गदूतो, उनकी स्तुति करो! हे स्वर्ग की सब सेनाओ, जो उनकी सेवा करती हो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ангелы; хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} воинства!
ru.B: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ангелы! Все небесные воинства, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!
ru.R: Все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ангелы, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! Все небесные войска, которые служат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!

ja.L: その方を賛美せよ、その方のすべての使いたちよ。その方を賛美せよ、その方のすべての軍勢よ！
ja.B: その方のすべての使いたちよ、その方を賛美せよ！天のすべての軍勢よ、その方を賛美せよ！
ja.R: すべての天使たちよ、その方を賛美せよ！その方に仕える天のすべての軍勢よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ангели; хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} воїнства!
uk.B: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ангели! Усі небесні війська, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!
uk.R: Усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ангели, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}! Усі небесні війська, що служать {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!

decisions.choice: his hosts: the words follow the form to be read
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another. The renderings follow the form to be read, "his hosts"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: hosts: the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: The word (tseva'ot, "armies") is used for God's angels (103:20-21; 1 Kings 22:19) and sometimes for the stars (Isaiah 40:26). Beside "his angels" it means the angels as God's army.

decisions.choice: the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: As in "the LORD of Armies", Balanced and Readable say "armies" for this word.

decisions.choice: "các đạo binh" (L); "các đạo quân trên trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The hosts are the armies of heaven (see the meaning decision). "cơ binh" is the old church word few readers use; Literal says "đạo binh" (army), and the other levels say whose armies, as the English does.

decisions.choice: सेनाओ (hosts, armies)
decisions.reason: The word is the one in "the LORD of hosts", सेनाओं के प्रभु in this translation, so Hindi says सेना at every level; Balanced and Readable add स्वर्ग की, as the English says "of heaven".

decisions.choice: воинства (L, B); небесные войска (R)
decisions.reason: The hosts are the armies of heaven (m2): "воинства", the word behind "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств", at Literal and Balanced, and the plain "войска" at Readable.

decisions.choice: mal'akhaw "その方の使いたち" (L, B), "天使たち" (R); tseva'aw "その方の軍勢" (L), "天の軍勢" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 103:20-21 (PSA-11); the hosts are the armies of heaven (m2, r-en-1); the form to be read is followed (m1).

source.text: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars of light.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, sun and moon; praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all stars of light!
en.B: Sun and moon, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! All shining stars, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.R: Sun and moon, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! Every bright star, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, soleil et lune ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, vous toutes, étoiles de lumière !
fr.B: Soleil et lune, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Vous toutes, étoiles brillantes, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !
fr.R: Soleil et lune, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Chaque étoile qui brille, loue-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !

sw.L: Msifuni, jua na mwezi; \q msifuni, nyota zote za nuru!
sw.B: Jua na mwezi, msifuni! \q Nyota zote zinazong'aa, msifuni!
sw.R: Jua na mwezi, msifuni! \q Kila nyota inayong'aa, msifuni!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, sol y luna; ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}, todas las estrellas luminosas!
es.B: Sol y luna, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}! Todas las estrellas brillantes, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!
es.R: Sol y luna, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}! Cada estrella brillante, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi mặt trời và mặt trăng; \q hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi tất cả các ngôi sao sáng!
vi.B: Hỡi mặt trời và mặt trăng, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hỡi tất cả các ngôi sao chiếu sáng, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Hỡi mặt trời và mặt trăng, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hỡi mọi ngôi sao sáng, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 해와 달아, 그분을 찬양하여라. \q 빛의 모든 별들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 해와 달아, 그분을 찬양하여라! \q 반짝이는 모든 별들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 해와 달아, 그분을 찬양하여라! \q 밝게 빛나는 별들아, 모두 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, sol e lua; louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, todas as estrelas de luz!
pt.B: Sol e lua, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}! Todas as estrelas brilhantes, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!
pt.R: Sol e lua, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}! Cada estrela brilhante, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!

am.L: አመስግኑት፣ ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፤ \q አመስግኑት፣ የብርሃን ከዋክብት ሁሉ!
am.B: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፣ አመስግኑት! \q የሚያበሩ ከዋክብት ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!
am.R: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፣ አመስግኑት! \q እናንተ ብሩህ ከዋክብት ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: हे सूर्य और चंद्रमा, उनकी स्तुति करो; हे सब ज्योतिर्मय तारो, उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.B: हे सूर्य और चंद्रमा, उनकी स्तुति करो! हे सब चमकते तारो, उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.R: हे सूरज और चाँद, उनकी स्तुति करो! हे हर चमकीले तारे, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, солнце и луна; хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, все звёзды света!
ru.B: Солнце и луна, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! Все сияющие звёзды, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!
ru.R: Солнце и луна, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! Каждая яркая звезда, хвали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!

ja.L: その方を賛美せよ、太陽と月よ。その方を賛美せよ、すべての光の星よ！
ja.B: 太陽よ、月よ、その方を賛美せよ！輝くすべての星よ、その方を賛美せよ！
ja.R: 太陽よ、月よ、その方を賛美せよ！明るく光るすべての星よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, сонце й місяцю; хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, усі зорі світла!
uk.B: Сонце й місяцю, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}! Усі сяйливі зорі, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!
uk.R: Сонце й місяцю, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}! Кожна яскрава зоре, хвали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!

decisions.choice: sun, moon and stars: creatures, not gods
decisions.reason: Israel's neighbors worshiped the sun, moon and stars as gods; Israel was warned not to (Deuteronomy 4:19). Here they are creatures called to praise their Maker (Genesis 1:14-18).

decisions.choice: stars of light: shining stars
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying the stars that give light.

source.text: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise him, heavens of the heavens, and the waters which [are] above the heavens.

en.L: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, heavens of the heavens, and the waters that [are] above the heavens!
en.B: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, heaven of heavens, along with the waters up above the sky!
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, highest heavens, and the waters high above the sky!

fr.L: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, cieux des cieux, et les eaux qui [sont] au-dessus des cieux !
fr.B: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, cieux des cieux, et vous, les eaux qui sont au-dessus du ciel !
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, cieux les plus hauts, et vous, les eaux tout là-haut au-dessus du ciel !

sw.L: Msifuni, mbingu za mbingu, \q na maji yaliyo juu ya mbingu!
sw.B: Msifuni, mbingu za juu kabisa, \q pamoja na maji yaliyo juu ya anga!
sw.R: Msifuni, mbingu zilizo juu kuliko zote, \q na maji yaliyo juu sana ya anga!

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, cielos de los cielos, y las aguas que [están] sobre los cielos!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, cielo de los cielos, junto con las aguas que están por encima del firmamento!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, cielos más altos, y las aguas que están muy por encima del cielo!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi trời của các tầng trời, \q và các dòng nước [ở] trên các tầng trời!
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi trời cao nhất, \q cùng các dòng nước ở trên bầu trời!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi các tầng trời cao nhất, \q và các dòng nước ở tít trên bầu trời!

ko.L: 하늘들의 하늘과 하늘 위에 있는 물들아, \q 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 하늘 위의 하늘아, \q 하늘 위에 있는 물과 함께 그분을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 가장 높은 하늘아, \q 하늘 위 높은 곳의 물아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, céus dos céus, e as águas que [estão] acima dos céus!
pt.B: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, céu dos céus, junto com as águas que estão lá em cima, acima do firmamento!
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, céus mais altos, e as águas bem acima do céu!

am.L: አመስግኑት፣ የሰማያት ሰማያት፣ \q ከሰማያትም በላይ ያሉ ውኆች!
am.B: ከሁሉ በላይ ያሉ ሰማያት፣ \q ከሰማይ በላይ ካሉት ውኆች ጋር አመስግኑት!
am.R: ከሁሉ በላይ ያለ ሰማይና ከሰማይ በላይ ያሉ ውኆች፣ \q አመስግኑት!

hi.L: हे आकाशों के आकाश, और हे जल जो आकाश के ऊपर [है], उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.B: हे सबसे ऊँचे आकाश, और आकाश के ऊपर के जल, उनकी स्तुति करो!
hi.R: हे सबसे ऊँचे स्वर्ग, और आकाश के बहुत ऊपर के जल, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, небеса небес, и воды, которые выше небес!
ru.B: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, небеса небес, вместе с водами, что над небосводом!
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, самые высокие небеса и воды высоко над небом!

ja.L: その方を賛美せよ、天の天よ、また天の上にある水よ！
ja.B: 天の天よ、天の上にある水とともに、その方を賛美せよ！
ja.R: いちばん高い天よ、空のはるか上にある水よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, небеса небес, і води, що понад небесами!
uk.B: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, небеса небес, разом із водами високо над небом!
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, найвищі небеса, і води високо над небом!

decisions.choice: heavens of the heavens: the highest heavens
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying the very highest heavens (Deuteronomy 10:14; 1 Kings 8:27).

decisions.choice: the waters above the heavens
decisions.reason: In the picture of the world in Genesis 1:7, God separated the waters above the dome of the sky from the waters below. Rain was pictured as coming from these upper waters (Genesis 7:11).

decisions.choice: "የሰማያት ሰማያት" (L), "ከሁሉ በላይ ያሉ ሰማያት" (B)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 10:14 on main, the phrase this verse shares (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: shemei hashamayim "天の天" (L, B), "いちばん高い天" (R); "天の上にある水"
decisions.reason: The highest heavens (m1) and the waters above (m2, as Genesis 1:7), kept as pictures.

source.text: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֭וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them praise [the] name of YHWH, for he commanded and they were created.

en.L: Let them praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded and they were created.
en.B: May they praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command they came into being.
en.R: All these things should praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He spoke the command, and they came to be.

fr.L: Qu’ils louent le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ordonné, et ils ont été créés.
fr.B: Qu’ils louent le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ordre ils sont venus à l’existence.
fr.R: Toutes ces choses doivent louer le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il a donné un ordre, et elles ont existé.

sw.L: Na walisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana aliamuru nao wakaumbwa.
sw.B: Na walisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q kwa agizo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} walipata kuwako.
sw.R: Vitu hivi vyote vinapaswa kulisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Alitoa amri, navyo vikawepo.

es.L: Que alaben el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mandó y fueron creados.
es.B: Que alaben el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mandato llegaron a existir.
es.R: Todas estas cosas deben alabar el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Él dio la orden, y llegaron a existir.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền lệnh và chúng được tạo nên.
vi.B: Nguyện chúng ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì theo lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng đã hiện hữu.
vi.R: Mọi vật ấy phải ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Ngài ra lệnh, và chúng đã có.

ko.L: 그것들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양하게 하여라. \q 그분께서 명령하시니 그것들이 창조되었다.
ko.B: 그것들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양하기를 바란다. \q 그분의 명령으로 그것들이 생겨났다.
ko.R: 이 모든 것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양해야 한다. \q 그분께서 명령하시자 그것들이 생겨났다.

pt.L: Que eles louvem o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ordenou e eles foram criados.
pt.B: Que eles louvem o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ordem eles passaram a existir.
pt.R: Todas essas coisas devem louvar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele deu a ordem, e elas passaram a existir.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ያመስግኑ፤ \q እርሱ አዘዘ፤ እነርሱም ተፈጠሩና።
am.R: እነዚህ ሁሉ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ያመስግኑ። \q እርሱ አዘዘ፤ እነርሱም ተፈጠሩ።

hi.L: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें, क्योंकि उन्होंने आज्ञा दी और वे सृजे गए।
hi.B: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें; उनकी आज्ञा से ही वे अस्तित्व में आए।
hi.R: ये सब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें। उन्होंने आज्ञा दी, और ये बन गए।

ru.L: Пусть хвалят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повелел, и они были сотворены.
ru.B: Пусть они хвалят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; по {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} повелению они возникли.
ru.R: Всё это должно хвалить имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Он отдал приказ, и всё это появилось.

ja.L: それらが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美するように。その方がお命じになり、それらは創造されたからである。
ja.B: それらが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美するように。その方がお命じになると、それらは造られた。
ja.R: これらのものはみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美すべきだ。その方が命令をお出しになると、それらができたのだから。

uk.L: Нехай хвалять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказав, і вони були створені.
uk.B: Нехай вони хвалять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}; за {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} наказом вони постали.
uk.R: Усе це має хвалити імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Він дав наказ, і все постало.

decisions.choice: Genesis 1; 33:9
decisions.reason: In Genesis 1 God speaks and things come to be. Psalm 33:9 says the same: "he commanded, and it stood".

decisions.choice: created: brought into being by God
decisions.reason: The verb (bara') is used in the Bible only with God as the one who creates (Genesis 1:1).

decisions.choice: them: all that verses 1-4 have named
decisions.reason: "Them" are the angels, armies, sun, moon, stars, heavens and waters.

decisions.choice: yehallelu "賛美するように" (L, B), "賛美すべきだ" (R, English R 'should'); tsivvah "お命じになり"; nivra'u "創造された" (L), "造られた" (B)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule for third-person jussives (PSA-12: 〜ように, R 〜べきだ where the English R says should); bara' 創造する (L), 造る (B) as 51:12; "お命じになる" avoids the passive-looking "命じられる" (PSA-14).

source.text: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חָק־נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he established them forever, forever; a decree he gave and it will not pass.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} established them forever and ever; a decree {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave, and it will not pass away.
en.B: He fixed them in their places for ever and always; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made a law for them that will not pass away.
en.R: He put them in their places to stay forever. He made rules for them that will never change.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a établis pour toujours, à jamais ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné une loi, et elle ne passera pas.
fr.B: Il les a fixés à leur place pour toujours et à jamais ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a donné une loi qui ne passera pas.
fr.R: Il les a mis à leur place pour qu’ils y restent toujours. Il leur a donné des règles qui ne changeront jamais.

sw.L: Naye aliwaweka imara milele na milele; \q alitoa amri, nayo haitapita.
sw.B: Aliwaweka mahali pao milele na milele; \q aliwawekea sheria isiyopita.
sw.R: Aliviweka mahali pake vikae milele. \q Aliviwekea kanuni ambazo hazitabadilika kamwe.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los estableció por siempre jamás; un decreto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio, y no pasará.
es.B: Él los fijó en su lugar por siempre jamás; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dio una ley que no pasará.
es.R: Él los puso en su lugar para que se quedaran allí para siempre. Les dio reglas que nunca cambiarán.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập chúng vững bền đời đời mãi mãi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban một sắc lệnh và nó sẽ không qua đi.
vi.B: Ngài đã đặt chúng vào chỗ của chúng đời đời mãi mãi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng một luật sẽ không bao giờ qua đi.
vi.R: Ngài đặt chúng vào chỗ của chúng để ở đó mãi mãi. \q Ngài làm ra những luật lệ cho chúng, sẽ không bao giờ thay đổi.

ko.L: 그분께서 그것들을 영원히 세우시고, 법을 주셨으니, \q 그것이 사라지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그것들을 영원토록 제자리에 두시고, \q 결코 없어지지 않을 법을 정해 주셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그것들을 제자리에 두셔서 영원히 있게 하셨다. \q 결코 바뀌지 않을 규칙을 정해 주셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os firmou para todo o sempre; um decreto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu, e não passará.
pt.B: Ele os fixou nos seus lugares para todo o sempre; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu uma lei que não passará.
pt.R: Ele os pôs nos seus lugares para ficarem para sempre. Ele lhes deu regras que nunca vão mudar.

am.L: ለዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም አጸናቸው፤ \q ሥርዓትን ሰጠ፤ አያልፍምም።
am.B: ለዘላለም በየስፍራቸው አጸናቸው፤ \q የማያልፍ ሕግም ሰጣቸው።
am.R: ለዘላለም እንዲኖሩ በየስፍራቸው አኖራቸው። \q ፈጽሞ የማይለወጥ ሥርዓትም ሰጣቸው።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उन्हें सदा-सर्वदा के लिए स्थिर किया; उन्होंने एक विधि दी, और वह टलेगी नहीं।
hi.B: उन्होंने उन्हें सदा-सर्वदा के लिए उनके स्थानों पर ठहराया; उन्होंने उनके लिए ऐसी विधि बनाई जो कभी नहीं टलेगी।
hi.R: उन्होंने उन्हें उनके स्थानों पर सदा के लिए रख दिया। उन्होंने उनके लिए ऐसे नियम बनाए जो कभी नहीं बदलेंगे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} утвердил их навек, навсегда; устав {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал, и он не прейдёт.
ru.B: Он поставил их на их места во веки веков; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал им закон, который не прейдёт.
ru.R: Он поставил их на их места навсегда. Он дал им правила, которые никогда не изменятся.

ja.L: その方はそれらを、いつまでも、とこしえに堅く立て、定めをお与えになった。それは過ぎ去ることがない。
ja.B: その方は、それらをとこしえに、いつまでもその場所に据え、過ぎ去ることのない定めをお与えになった。
ja.R: その方は、それらがいつまでも、そこにとどまるようにしてくださった。決して変わらないきまりを、お与えになった。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} утвердив їх навіки-віків; постанову {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав, і вона не мине.
uk.B: Він поставив їх на їхні місця на віки вічні; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їм закон, що не мине.
uk.R: Він поставив їх на їхні місця, щоб вони залишалися там навіки. Він дав їм правила, які ніколи не зміняться.

decisions.choice: it will not pass: the decree will not pass away
alternatives: they will not go beyond it
decisions.reason: The verb ('avar) can mean to pass away or to pass over a limit. The line may say that God's decree will never lapse, or that the things he made will not break the law he set for them, as the sea does not pass its boundary (Jeremiah 5:22).

decisions.choice: a decree: a fixed law
decisions.reason: The word (choq) is a law laid down; Jeremiah 33:25 speaks of God's fixed laws for heaven and earth.

decisions.choice: choq "定め" (L, B), "きまり" (R); velo' ya'avor "過ぎ去ることがない" (L, B), "決して変わらない" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter word for choq (PSA-1, PSA-13); 'it' is read as the decree (m1, uncertain).

records.literal_gloss: Praise YHWH from the earth, sea monsters and all deeps,

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the earth, sea monsters and all [the] deeps,
en.B: From the earth below, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, sea monsters and all the watery deeps,
en.R: Everything on earth, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Huge creatures in the sea and all the deep oceans, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis la terre, monstres marins et tous [les] abîmes,
fr.B: Depuis la terre en bas, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, monstres marins et toutes les profondeurs des eaux,
fr.R: Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Énormes animaux de la mer et océans profonds, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka duniani, \q enyi majoka ya baharini na vilindi vyote,
sw.B: Kutoka duniani chini, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q enyi majoka ya baharini na vilindi vyote vya maji,
sw.R: Vyote vilivyo duniani, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Viumbe wakubwa wa baharini na bahari zote zenye kina, msifuni!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde la tierra, monstruos marinos y todos [los] abismos,
es.B: Desde la tierra abajo, {{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, monstruos marinos y todos los abismos de las aguas,
es.R: Todo lo que hay en la tierra, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Criaturas enormes del mar y todos los océanos profundos, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}!

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ đất, \q hỡi các thủy quái và mọi vực sâu,
vi.B: Từ dưới đất, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q hỡi các thủy quái và mọi vực nước sâu,
vi.R: Hỡi mọi vật trên đất, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hỡi những sinh vật khổng lồ dưới biển và mọi đại dương sâu thẳm, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 땅에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라, \q 바다 괴물들과 모든 깊은 곳들아,
ko.B: 아래 땅에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라, \q 바다의 큰 짐승들과 깊은 모든 바다야,
ko.R: 땅에 있는 모든 것아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! \q 바다의 거대한 짐승들과 깊은 바다들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desde a terra, monstros marinhos e todos [os] abismos,
pt.B: Desde a terra aqui embaixo, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, monstros marinhos e todos os abismos das águas,
pt.R: Tudo o que há na terra, louve {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Criaturas enormes do mar e todos os oceanos profundos, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከምድር አመስግኑ፣ \q ታላላቅ የባሕር ፍጥረታትና ጥልቆች ሁሉ፣
am.B: በምድር ያላችሁ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ፤ \q ታላላቅ የባሕር ፍጥረታትና ውኃማ ጥልቆች ሁሉ፣
am.R: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ! \q ታላላቅ የባሕር ፍጥረታትና ጥልቅ ውቅያኖሶች ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: पृथ्वी पर से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो, हे समुद्री अजगरो और सब गहरे सागरो,
hi.B: नीचे पृथ्वी पर से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो, हे समुद्र के बड़े जंतुओ और सब गहरे जल,
hi.R: पृथ्वी की हर वस्तु, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! हे समुद्र के विशाल जीवो और सब गहरे महासागरो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} с земли, морские чудовища и все бездны,
ru.B: С земли внизу хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, морские чудовища и все водные бездны,
ru.R: Всё, что на земле, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Огромные морские существа и все глубокие океаны, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}!

ja.L: 地から{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ、海の怪物たちよ、すべての深淵よ、
ja.B: 地から{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ、竜よ、すべての深い淵よ、
ja.R: 地上にあるすべてのものよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美せよ！海にいる大きな怪物たちよ、すべての深い海よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} з землі, морські чудовиська й усі безодні,
uk.B: З землі внизу хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, морські чудовиська й усі водяні глибини,
uk.R: Усе на землі, хвали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Величезні морські створіння й усі глибокі океани, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!

decisions.choice: sea monsters: the great creatures of the sea
decisions.reason: The word (tanninim) is used of the great sea creatures God made (Genesis 1:21) and of the sea monster that stands for chaos (74:13; Isaiah 27:1). Even these are called to praise.

decisions.choice: the deeps: the depths of the sea
decisions.reason: The word (tehomot) is the deep waters of Genesis 1:2.

decisions.choice: a list that runs on
decisions.reason: Those called on to praise the LORD from the earth are named through verse 12, so verses 7-11 end with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: praise him
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the call to praise with each group, in short sentences.

decisions.choice: "các thủy quái" (L, B) for the sea monsters; "những sinh vật khổng lồ dưới biển" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means the great creatures of the sea (see the meaning decision); "thủy quái" keeps their strangeness without naming one animal, and Readable describes them, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ታላላቅ የባሕር ፍጥረታት" (the great sea creatures), "ጥልቆች" (the deeps)
decisions.reason: The tanninim are the great sea creatures God made in Genesis 1:21 (meaning decision m1), and the Amharic of Genesis 1:21 on main is kept so the reader hears the order of creation (meaning decision m2 on verse 1).

decisions.choice: समुद्री अजगर (L); समुद्र के बड़े जंतु (B); समुद्र के विशाल जीव (R)
decisions.reason: The tanninim are the great sea creatures of Genesis 1:21; Literal keeps a word that can also suggest the sea monster of other passages, Balanced and Readable describe them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: tanninim "海の怪物たち" (L), "竜" (B), "海にいる大きな怪物たち" (R); tehomot "深淵" (L), "深い淵" (B), "深い海" (R)
decisions.reason: As 74:13 (PSA-8) and 33:7 (PSA-3); the great creatures and depths of the sea (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: L and B keep 148:7-12 as one list of vocatives, each verse ending with 、 and 148:12 closing with ！; R makes each verse its own call with "その方を賛美せよ！"
decisions.reason: The English L and B run the list on (m3); the English R supplies 'praise him' in each verse (r-en-1), which R follows.

source.text: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: fire and hail, snow and smoke, wind of storm doing his word,

en.L: fire and hail, snow and smoke, stormy wind doing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word,
en.B: fire and hail, snow and fog, gales of wind that do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says,
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, lightning and hail, snow and fog, and the strong winds that obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: feu et grêle, neige et fumée, vent de tempête qui fait {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole,
fr.B: feu et grêle, neige et brouillard, vents de tempête qui font ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit,
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, éclairs et grêle, neige et brouillard, et vous, les vents forts qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent !

sw.L: moto na mvua ya mawe, theluji na moshi, \q upepo wa dhoruba unaofanya neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}},
sw.B: moto na mvua ya mawe, theluji na ukungu, \q pepo kali zinazofanya anachosema,
sw.R: Msifuni, umeme na mvua ya mawe, \q theluji na ukungu, na pepo kali zinazomtii!

es.L: fuego y granizo, nieve y humo, viento tempestuoso que cumple {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra,
es.B: fuego y granizo, nieve y niebla, vendavales que hacen lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, relámpagos y granizo, nieve y niebla, y los vientos fuertes que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen!

vi.L: lửa và mưa đá, tuyết và khói, \q gió bão làm theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: lửa và mưa đá, tuyết và sương mù, \q những cơn gió bão làm theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán,
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi chớp lửa và mưa đá, \q tuyết và sương mù, và những cơn gió mạnh vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 불과 우박, 눈과 연기, \q 그분의 말씀을 행하는 폭풍아,
ko.B: 번개와 우박, 눈과 안개, \q 그분의 말씀대로 하는 세찬 바람아,
ko.R: 번개와 우박아, 눈과 안개야, \q 그분께 순종하는 거센 바람아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: fogo e granizo, neve e fumaça, vento tempestuoso que cumpre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra,
pt.B: fogo e granizo, neve e neblina, ventos fortes que fazem o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz,
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, relâmpagos e granizo, neve e neblina, e os ventos fortes que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecem!

am.L: እሳትና የበረዶ ድንጋይ፣ በረዶና ጢስ፣ \q ቃሉን የሚፈጽም ዐውሎ ነፋስ፣
am.B: እሳትና የበረዶ ድንጋይ፣ በረዶና ጭጋግ፣ \q የሚለውን የሚፈጽሙ ብርቱ ነፋሳት፣
am.R: መብረቅና የበረዶ ድንጋይ፣ በረዶና ጭጋግ፣ \q እርሱን የምትታዘዙ ብርቱ ነፋሳት ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: आग और ओले, हिम और धुआँ, आँधी जो उनका वचन पूरा करती है,
hi.B: आग और ओले, बर्फ़ और कोहरा, प्रचंड हवाएँ जो उनका कहा करती हैं,
hi.R: हे बिजली और ओलो, बर्फ़ और कोहरे, और तेज़ हवाओ जो उनकी आज्ञा मानती हो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: огонь и град, снег и дым, бурный ветер, исполняющий {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слово,
ru.B: огонь и град, снег и туман, порывы ветра, которые исполняют то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит,
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, молнии и град, снег и туман, и сильные ветры, которые {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} послушны!

ja.L: 火よ、雹よ、雪よ、煙よ、その方の言葉を行う激しい風よ、
ja.B: 火よ、雹よ、雪よ、霧よ、その方の言葉のとおりに吹く嵐の風よ、
ja.R: 稲妻よ、ひょうよ、雪よ、霧よ、その方に従う強い風よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: вогонь і граде, сніже й диме, вітре бурі, що виконуєш {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слово,
uk.B: вогонь і граде, сніже й тумане, буйні вітри, що чините те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже,
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, блискавко й граде, сніже й тумане, і сильні вітри, що слухаються {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}!

decisions.choice: fire: lightning
decisions.reason: Fire with hail is lightning in a storm (18:13-14; Exodus 9:23-24).

decisions.choice: smoke: thick mist or cloud
decisions.reason: The word (qitor) is smoke (Genesis 19:28); in weather it is fog or low cloud.
The weather does God's word, as Psalm 147:15-18 has just described.

decisions.choice: lightning
decisions.reason: Readable says what fire in a storm is (m1).

decisions.choice: "የበረዶ ድንጋይ" (hail) and "በረዶ" (snow)
decisions.reason: Amharic "በረዶ" covers snow and ice; "የበረዶ ድንጋይ" keeps hail apart, as in 147:16-17.

decisions.choice: 'esh "火" (L, B), "稲妻" (R); qitor "煙" (L), "霧" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Fire is lightning (m1, r-en-1); qitor is a thick mist or cloud (m2, uncertain); the wind doing his word echoes 147:15-18 (m3).

records.literal_gloss: the mountains and all hills, fruit tree[s] and all cedars,

en.L: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
en.B: the mountains and all the hills, trees that bear fruit and all the cedars,
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, mountains and hills, every fruit tree and every cedar!

fr.L: montagnes et toutes collines, arbres fruitiers et tous cèdres,
fr.B: les montagnes et toutes les collines, les arbres qui portent du fruit et tous les cèdres,
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, montagnes et collines, chaque arbre fruitier et chaque cèdre !

sw.L: milima na vilima vyote, \q miti ya matunda na mierezi yote,
sw.B: milima na vilima vyote, \q miti izaayo matunda na mierezi yote,
sw.R: Msifuni, milima na vilima, \q kila mti wa matunda na kila mwerezi!

es.L: montes y todas las colinas, árboles frutales y todos los cedros,
es.B: los montes y todas las colinas, los árboles que dan fruto y todos los cedros,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, montes y colinas, cada árbol frutal y cada cedro!

vi.L: núi non và mọi đồi, \q cây ăn trái và mọi cây bá hương,
vi.B: núi non và mọi đồi cao, \q cây sinh trái và mọi cây bá hương,
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi núi non và đồi cao, \q mọi cây ăn trái và mọi cây bá hương!

ko.L: 산들과 모든 언덕들, \q 열매 맺는 나무들과 모든 백향목들아,
ko.B: 산들과 모든 언덕, \q 열매 맺는 나무들과 모든 백향목아,
ko.R: 산과 언덕들아, 모든 과일나무와 모든 백향목아, \q 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: montes e todas as colinas, árvores frutíferas e todos os cedros,
pt.B: os montes e todas as colinas, as árvores que dão fruto e todos os cedros,
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, montes e colinas, toda árvore frutífera e todo cedro!

am.L: ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች ሁሉ፣ \q የፍሬ ዛፎችና ዝግባዎች ሁሉ፣
am.B: ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች ሁሉ፣ \q ፍሬ የሚያፈሩ ዛፎችና ዝግባዎች ሁሉ፣
am.R: ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች፣ \q የፍሬ ዛፎችና ዝግባዎች ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: पहाड़ और सब पहाड़ियाँ, फलदार वृक्ष और सब देवदार,
hi.B: पहाड़ और सब पहाड़ियाँ, फल देनेवाले वृक्ष और सब देवदार,
hi.R: हे पहाड़ो और पहाड़ियो, हे हर फलदार पेड़ और हर देवदार, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: горы и все холмы, плодовые деревья и все кедры,
ru.B: горы и все холмы, деревья, приносящие плод, и все кедры,
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, горы и холмы, каждое плодовое дерево и каждый кедр!

ja.L: 山々よ、すべての丘よ、実を結ぶ木よ、すべての杉よ、
ja.B: 山々よ、すべての丘よ、実のなる木々よ、すべての杉よ、
ja.R: 山々よ、丘よ、すべての実のなる木よ、すべての杉の木よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: гори й усі пагорби, плодові дерева й усі кедри,
uk.B: гори й усі пагорби, дерева, що родять плоди, і всі кедри,
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, гори й пагорби, кожне плодове дерево й кожен кедр!

decisions.choice: cedars: the tallest trees
decisions.reason: The cedars of Lebanon were the greatest trees Israel knew (104:16); they stand beside the trees that give food.

records.literal_gloss: the wild animal[s] and all livestock, creeping thing[s] and bird[s] of wing,

en.L: wild animals and all livestock, creeping things and winged birds,
en.B: wild beasts and all cattle, creatures that crawl and birds that fly,
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, wild animals and farm animals, creatures that crawl and birds that fly!

fr.L: bêtes sauvages et tout bétail, reptiles et oiseaux ailés,
fr.B: bêtes sauvages et tout le bétail, créatures qui rampent et oiseaux qui volent,
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, animaux sauvages et animaux de la ferme, bêtes qui rampent et oiseaux qui volent !

sw.L: wanyama wa porini na mifugo yote, \q viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege wenye mabawa,
sw.B: wanyama wa mwituni na ng'ombe wote, \q viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege warukao,
sw.R: Msifuni, wanyama wa porini na wanyama wa kufugwa, \q viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege warukao!

es.L: animales salvajes y todo el ganado, reptiles y aves aladas,
es.B: bestias salvajes y todo el ganado, criaturas que se arrastran y aves que vuelan,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, animales salvajes y animales de granja, criaturas que se arrastran y aves que vuelan!

vi.L: thú hoang và mọi súc vật, \q loài bò sát và chim có cánh,
vi.B: thú rừng và mọi gia súc, \q loài bò sát và loài chim bay,
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi thú rừng và gia súc, \q loài bò sát và loài chim bay!

ko.L: 들짐승과 모든 가축, \q 기는 것들과 날개 달린 새들아,
ko.B: 들짐승과 모든 가축, \q 기어 다니는 것들과 날아다니는 새들아,
ko.R: 들짐승과 집짐승들아, \q 기어 다니는 것들과 날아다니는 새들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: animais selvagens e todo o gado, répteis e aves que voam,
pt.B: feras e todo o gado, criaturas que rastejam e pássaros que voam,
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, animais selvagens e animais do campo, criaturas que rastejam e pássaros que voam!

am.L: አራዊትና ከብቶች ሁሉ፣ በምድር ላይ \q የሚሳቡና ክንፍ ያላቸው ወፎች፣
am.B: የዱር አራዊትና ከብቶች ሁሉ፣ \q በምድር ላይ የሚሳቡ ፍጥረታትና የሚበርሩ ወፎች፣
am.R: የዱር አራዊትና የቤት እንስሳት፣ \q የሚሳቡ ትናንሽ ፍጥረታትና የሚበርሩ ወፎች፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: वन-पशु और सब घरेलू पशु, रेंगनेवाले जंतु और पंखवाले पक्षी,
hi.B: जंगली पशु और सब मवेशी, रेंगनेवाले जीव और उड़नेवाले पक्षी,
hi.R: हे जंगली जानवरो और पालतू पशुओ, रेंगनेवाले जीवो और उड़नेवाले पक्षियो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: дикие звери и весь скот, пресмыкающиеся и птицы крылатые,
ru.B: дикие звери и весь скот, ползающие существа и летающие птицы,
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, дикие и домашние животные, ползающие существа и летающие птицы!

ja.L: 獣よ、すべての家畜よ、はうものよ、翼のある鳥よ、
ja.B: 野の獣よ、すべての家畜よ、地をはうものよ、空を飛ぶ鳥よ、
ja.R: 野生の動物よ、家畜よ、地をはう生き物よ、空を飛ぶ鳥よ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: дикі звірі й уся худоба, плазуни й крилаті птахи,
uk.B: дикі звірі й уся худоба, створіння, що плазують, і птахи, що літають,
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, дикі звірі й свійські тварини, створіння, що повзають, і птахи, що літають!

decisions.choice: Genesis 1:24-25
decisions.reason: The same three kinds of land creatures, wild animals, livestock and creeping things, are made on the sixth day (Genesis 1:24-25), and the birds on the fifth (Genesis 1:20-21).

decisions.choice: "አራዊት", "ከብቶች", "በምድር ላይ የሚሳቡ", "ክንፍ ያላቸው ወፎች" (R "የዱር አራዊት", "የቤት እንስሳት", "ትናንሽ ፍጥረታት")
decisions.reason: The creatures of Genesis 1:20-25 (meaning decision m1), in the words settled for Genesis 1 on main.

decisions.choice: chayyah "獣", behemah "家畜", remes "はうもの"
decisions.reason: The creatures of Genesis 1:24-25 (m1) in the forms of 104 (PSA-11).

records.literal_gloss: kings of [the] earth and all peoples, officials and all judges of [the] earth,

en.L: kings of [the] earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of [the] earth,
en.B: earthly kings and all peoples, nobles and all the earth's rulers,
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, kings and all the nations of the world, leaders and everyone who governs on earth!

fr.L: rois de [la] terre et tous les peuples, princes et tous les juges de [la] terre,
fr.B: rois de la terre et tous les peuples, grands et tous les dirigeants de la terre,
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, rois et toutes les nations du monde, chefs et tous ceux qui gouvernent sur la terre !

sw.L: wafalme wa dunia na watu wote, \q wakuu na waamuzi wote wa dunia,
sw.B: wafalme wa dunia na mataifa yote, \q wakuu na watawala wote wa dunia,
sw.R: Msifuni, wafalme na mataifa yote ya ulimwengu, \q viongozi na wote wanaotawala duniani!

es.L: reyes de [la] tierra y todos los pueblos, príncipes y todos los jueces de [la] tierra,
es.B: reyes de la tierra y todos los pueblos, nobles y todos los gobernantes de la tierra,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, reyes y todas las naciones del mundo, líderes y todos los que gobiernan en la tierra!

vi.L: các vua [trên] đất và mọi dân tộc, \q các quan trưởng và mọi quan xét [trên] đất,
vi.B: các vua trên đất và mọi dân tộc, \q các quan chức và mọi nhà cầm quyền trên đất,
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi các vua và mọi dân tộc trên thế giới, \q các nhà lãnh đạo và tất cả những ai cai trị trên đất!

ko.L: 땅의 왕들과 모든 백성들, \q 고관들과 땅의 모든 재판관들아,
ko.B: 세상의 왕들과 모든 백성, \q 귀족들과 땅의 모든 통치자들아,
ko.R: 왕들과 세상의 모든 민족들아, \q 지도자들과 땅을 다스리는 모든 이들아, 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: reis da terra e todos os povos, príncipes e todos os juízes da terra,
pt.B: reis da terra e todos os povos, nobres e todos os governantes da terra,
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, reis e todas as nações do mundo, líderes e todos os que governam na terra!

am.L: የምድር ነገሥታትና ሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ \q መኳንንትና የምድር ፈራጆች ሁሉ፣
am.B: የምድር ነገሥታትና ሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ \q መኳንንትና የምድር ገዥዎች ሁሉ፣
am.R: ነገሥታትና የዓለም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ \q መሪዎችና በምድር የሚገዙ ሁሉ፣ አመስግኑት!

hi.L: पृथ्वी के राजा और सब लोग, हाकिम और पृथ्वी के सब न्यायी,
hi.B: पृथ्वी के राजा और सब देशों के लोग, प्रधान और पृथ्वी के सब शासक,
hi.R: हे राजाओ और संसार के सब देशो, हे अगुवो और पृथ्वी पर शासन करनेवाले सब लोगो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: цари земли и все племена, князья и все судьи земли,
ru.B: земные цари и все племена, знатные люди и все правители земли,
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, цари и все народы мира, вожди и все, кто правит на земле!

ja.L: 地の王たちよ、すべての民らよ、長たちよ、地のすべての裁く者たちよ、
ja.B: 地の王たちよ、すべての民らよ、指導者たちよ、地のすべての支配者たちよ、
ja.R: 地上の王たちよ、世界のすべての人々よ、指導者たちよ、地上で国を治めるすべての人たちよ、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: царі землі й усі племена, князі й усі судді землі,
uk.B: земні царі й усі племена, вельможі й усі правителі землі,
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, царі й усі народи світу, провідники й усі, хто править на землі!

decisions.choice: judges: rulers who govern
decisions.reason: The word (shofetim) is used of those who rule and decide cases, as in 2:10. The rulers of the earth are called to praise the King above them.

decisions.choice: malkhei 'erets "地の王たち" (L, B), "地上の王たち" (R); le'ummim "民ら" (L, B), "人々" (R); sarim "長たち" (L), "指導者たち" (B, R); shofetei 'arets "裁く者たち" (L), "支配者たち" (B)
decisions.reason: Psalter words (PSA-1, PSA-7); the judges are rulers who govern (m1).

records.literal_gloss: young men and also young women, old [ones] with youths.

en.L: young men and also young women, old [ones] with youths!
en.B: young men and young women alike, the old together with the young!
en.R: Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, young men and young women, old people and children!

fr.L: jeunes hommes et aussi jeunes filles, vieillards avec les enfants !
fr.B: jeunes gens et jeunes filles ensemble, vieillards et enfants réunis !
fr.R: Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, jeunes hommes et jeunes filles, personnes âgées et enfants !

sw.L: vijana wa kiume na pia wasichana, \q wazee pamoja na vijana!
sw.B: vijana wa kiume na wa kike pia, \q wazee pamoja na vijana!
sw.R: Msifuni, vijana wa kiume na wa kike, \q wazee na watoto!

es.L: jóvenes y también doncellas, ¡ancianos junto con muchachos!
es.B: ¡jóvenes y muchachas por igual, los ancianos junto con los jóvenes!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alábenlo|Alabadlo}}, jóvenes y muchachas, ancianos y niños!

vi.L: các thanh niên và cả các thiếu nữ, \q người già cùng với người trẻ!
vi.B: cả thanh niên lẫn thiếu nữ, \q người già cùng với người trẻ!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi các chàng trai và cô gái, \q người già và trẻ em!

ko.B: 젊은 남자들과 젊은 여자들이 다 함께, \q 늙은이와 젊은이가 함께!
ko.R: 젊은 남자들과 젊은 여자들아, 노인들과 아이들아, \q 그분을 찬양하여라!

pt.L: rapazes e também moças, velhos com jovens!
pt.B: rapazes e moças, os velhos junto com os jovens!
pt.R: Louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}, rapazes e moças, idosos e crianças!

am.L: ጎበዛዝትና ቆነጃጅት ደግሞ፣ \q ሽማግሌዎች ከብላቴኖች ጋር!
am.B: ወጣት ወንዶችና ወጣት ሴቶች በአንድነት፣ \q ሽማግሌዎች ከወጣቶች ጋር!
am.R: ወጣት ወንዶችና ወጣት ሴቶች፣ ሽማግሌዎችና ልጆች፣ \q አመስግኑት!

hi.L: जवान पुरुष और कुँवारियाँ भी, बूढ़े लड़कों के साथ!
hi.B: जवान पुरुष और जवान स्त्रियाँ दोनों, बूढ़े और जवान एक साथ!
hi.R: हे जवान पुरुषो और जवान स्त्रियो, बूढ़ो और बच्चो, उनकी स्तुति करो!

ru.L: юноши и также девушки, старцы с отроками!
ru.B: юноши и девушки вместе, старые вместе с молодыми!
ru.R: Хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, юноши и девушки, старики и дети!

ja.L: 若い男たちよ、また若い女たちよ、年老いた者たちよ、若い者たちと共に！
ja.B: 若い男たちも若い女たちも、年老いた者も若い者も、共に！
ja.R: 若い男の人たちも、若い女の人たちも、年をとった人たちも、子どもたちも、その方を賛美せよ！

uk.L: юнаки, а також дівчата, старі разом з молодими!
uk.B: і юнаки, і дівчата, старі разом з молодими!
uk.R: Хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, юнаки й дівчата, старі люди й діти!

decisions.choice: young women: girls of marrying age
decisions.reason: The word (betulot) is young women not yet married.

decisions.choice: old with youths: old and young people together
decisions.reason: The words (zeqenim, ne'arim) are masculine plurals, which in Hebrew cover men and women alike; the line takes in every age.

decisions.choice: "thanh niên" and "thiếu nữ" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The verse names young men and young women side by side, so each word means what it says, as in the English, which has no span here either.

decisions.choice: bachurim / betulot "若い男たち" / "若い女たち"; zeqenim 'im-ne'arim "年老いた者たち…若い者たちと共に" (L), "子どもたち" (R)
decisions.reason: Young women of marrying age (m1) and old and young together (m2); no gender span is needed since the sexes are named.

source.text: יְהַלְל֤וּ׀אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them praise [the] name of YHWH, for exalted [is] his name alone; his splendor [is] above earth and heavens.

en.L: Let them praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name alone is exalted; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} majesty [is] above earth and heavens.
en.B: Let them all bring praise to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name alone is lifted high; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} splendor towers over earth and sky.
en.R: Let them all praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. His name is the only one that is truly great. His majesty is far above the earth and the sky.

fr.L: Qu’ils louent le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom seul est élevé ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} majesté [est] au-dessus de la terre et des cieux.
fr.B: Qu’ils louent tous le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, puisque {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom seul est élevé bien haut ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} splendeur domine la terre et le ciel.
fr.R: Qu’ils louent tous le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Son nom est le seul qui soit vraiment grand. Sa majesté est bien au-dessus de la terre et du ciel.

sw.L: Na walisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} peke yake limetukuka; \q fahari {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [iko] juu ya nchi na mbingu.
sw.B: Na wote walisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kuwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} peke yake limeinuliwa juu; \q utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unapita nchi na anga.
sw.R: Wote na walisifu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ndilo pekee lililo kuu kweli. \q Enzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iko juu sana ya dunia na anga.

es.L: Que alaben el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque solo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es excelso; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} majestad [está] sobre la tierra y los cielos.
es.B: Que todos alaben el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ya que solo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es exaltado; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} esplendor se eleva sobre la tierra y el cielo.
es.R: Que todos alaben el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Su nombre es el único que es verdaderamente grande. Su majestad está muy por encima de la tierra y del cielo.

vi.L: Nguyện chúng ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì chỉ một mình danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao; \q sự uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trên đất và trời.
vi.B: Nguyện tất cả cùng ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì chỉ một mình danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao; \q vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vượt trên đất và trời.
vi.R: Nguyện tất cả cùng ca ngợi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Chỉ có danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thật sự vĩ đại. \q Sự uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cao vượt hơn cả đất và trời.

ko.L: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양하게 하여라. 그분의 이름만이 높으시고, \q 그분의 위엄이 땅과 하늘 위에 [있기] 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양하게 하여라. 그분의 이름만이 높임을 받으시고, \q 그분의 영광이 땅과 하늘 위에 우뚝 솟아 있다.
ko.R: 그들이 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 찬양하게 하여라. \q 참으로 위대한 이름은 그분의 이름뿐이다. \q 그분의 위엄은 땅과 하늘보다 훨씬 높다.

pt.L: Que eles louvem o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois só o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é exaltado; a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} majestade [está] acima da terra e dos céus.
pt.B: Que todos eles louvem o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois só o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é exaltado; o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} esplendor se eleva acima da terra e do céu.
pt.R: Que todos eles louvem o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é o único que é grande de verdade. A {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} majestade está muito acima da terra e do céu.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ያመስግኑ፤ ስሙ ብቻውን ከፍ ያለ ነውና፤ \q ግርማው ከምድርና ከሰማያት በላይ [ነው]።
am.B: ሁሉም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ያመስግኑ፤ ከፍ ከፍ ያለው ስሙ ብቻ ነውና፤ \q ግርማው ከምድርና ከሰማይ በላይ ነው።
am.R: ሁሉም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም ያመስግኑ። \q በእውነት ታላቅ የሆነው ስሙ ብቻ ነው። \q ግርማው ከምድርና ከሰማይ እጅግ በላይ ነው።

hi.L: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें, क्योंकि केवल उन्हीं का नाम ऊँचा [है]; उनका प्रताप पृथ्वी और आकाश के ऊपर [है]।
hi.B: वे सब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें, क्योंकि केवल उन्हीं का नाम ऊँचा किया गया है; उनका वैभव पृथ्वी और आकाश से ऊपर उठा है।
hi.R: वे सब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम की स्तुति करें। केवल उन्हीं का नाम सचमुच महान है। उनका प्रताप पृथ्वी और आकाश से बहुत ऊपर है।

ru.L: Пусть хвалят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, ведь только {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя превознесено; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} величие — над землёй и небесами.
ru.B: Пусть все они хвалят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что только {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя высоко превознесено; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} великолепие возвышается над землёй и небом.
ru.R: Пусть все хвалят имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Только {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя по-настоящему велико. Его величие намного выше земли и неба.

ja.L: それらが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美するように。その方の名だけが高くあげられ、その威光は地と天の上にあるからである。
ja.B: それらがみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美するように。その方の名だけが高くあがめられ、その輝きは地と天の上にそびえているから。
ja.R: これらのものがみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を賛美するように。本当に偉大な名は、その方の名だけだ。その方の威厳は、地よりも空よりも、はるかに高い。

uk.L: Нехай хвалять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо лише {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя піднесене; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} величність — над землею й небесами.
uk.B: Нехай усі віддають хвалу імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо лише {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя піднесене; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} пишнота височіє над землею й небом.
uk.R: Нехай усі хвалять імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Його імʼя — єдине, яке справді велике. Його величність набагато вища за землю й небо.

decisions.choice: his name alone: only his name
decisions.reason: No other name is to be lifted up beside his (Isaiah 2:11, 17). The call to praise repeats verse 5, closing the earthly half as verse 5 closed the heavenly half.

decisions.choice: splendor: majesty
decisions.reason: The word (hod) is the majesty of a king (8:2; 104:1).

decisions.choice: the only one that is truly great
decisions.reason: Readable says what it means for his name alone to be lifted high.

decisions.choice: yehallelu "賛美するように" (every level, English R 'Let'); hodo "その威光" (L), "その輝き" (B), "その方の威厳" (R)
decisions.reason: Third-person jussive 〜ように (PSA-12); the passive 高くあげられ is a true passive of the name (m1).

source.text: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן׀לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his faithful [ones], for [the] sons of Israel, a people near him. Praise Yah!

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has raised up a horn for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, praise for all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful [ones], for the sons of Israel, a people near to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has raised up a horn, a source of praise for all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful, the Israelites, a people near to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: He has made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people strong. This gives all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people a reason to praise. They are the people of Israel, the people who are close to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a élevé une corne pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, louange pour tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles, pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, un peuple proche de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a élevé une corne, sujet de louange pour tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, un peuple proche de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Il a rendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple fort. Cela donne à tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles une raison de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer. Ce sont les Israélites, le peuple qui est proche de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Naye amewainulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} pembe, sifa kwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, \q kwa wana wa Israeli, watu walio karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} amewainulia pembe, sababu ya sifa kwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, \q Waisraeli, watu walio karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Amewafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa na nguvu. Jambo hili linawapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote waaminifu sababu ya kusifu. \q Wao ni watu wa Israeli, watu walio karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha levantado un cuerno para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, alabanza para todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles, para los hijos de Israel, pueblo cercano a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: Para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha levantado un cuerno, motivo de alabanza para todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles, los israelitas, un pueblo cercano a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: Él ha hecho fuerte a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Esto les da a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles un motivo para alabar. Son el pueblo de Israel, el pueblo que está cerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nâng một cái sừng lên cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [là] lời ca ngợi cho tất cả những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q cho con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên, một dân gần gũi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.B: Ngài đã nâng sừng lên cho chính dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, làm lý do ca ngợi cho mọi người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, một dân ở gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được mạnh mẽ. Điều đó cho mọi người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có lý do để ca ngợi. \q Họ là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, là dân ở gần bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 백성을 위하여 뿔을 높이셨으니, 그분의 모든 신실한 이들, \q 곧 그분께 가까운 백성인 이스라엘 자손에게 찬양이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 그분께서 그분의 백성을 위하여 뿔을 높이 드셨으니, 그것은 그분의 모든 신실한 백성, \q 곧 그분께 가까이 있는 백성인 이스라엘 자손의 찬양거리이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 그분께서 그분의 백성을 강하게 하셨다. 그래서 그분의 신실한 백성이 모두 찬양할 이유가 생겼다. \q 그들은 이스라엘 백성, 곧 그분께 가까이 있는 백성이다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} levantou um chifre para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, louvor para todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} fiéis, para os filhos de Israel, um povo próximo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Aleluia!
pt.B: Para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} levantou um chifre, motivo de louvor para todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} fiéis, os israelitas, um povo próximo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Aleluia!
pt.R: Ele tornou forte o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. Isso dá a todo o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo fiel um motivo para louvar. Eles são o povo de Israel, o povo que está perto {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Iá}}!

am.L: ለሕዝቡም ቀንድን ከፍ አደረገ፤ ለታማኞቹ ሁሉ፣ ለእስራኤል ልጆች፣ \q ወደ እርሱ ቅርብ ለሆነ ሕዝብ ምስጋና [ነው]። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.B: ለገዛ ሕዝቡ ቀንድን ከፍ አደረገ፤ ይህም ለታማኞቹ ሁሉ፣ \q ለእርሱ ቅርብ ለሆነው ሕዝብ ለእስራኤላውያን የምስጋና ምክንያት ነው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!
am.R: ሕዝቡን ብርቱ አደረገ። ይህም ታማኝ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሚያመሰግኑበት ምክንያት ሆነ። \q እነርሱም የእስራኤል ሕዝብ፣ ለእርሱ ቅርብ የሆኑ ሕዝብ ናቸው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህን}} አመስግኑ!

hi.L: और उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा के लिए एक सींग ऊँचा किया है, अपने सब भक्तों के लिए स्तुति, {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} के लिए, उस प्रजा के लिए जो उनके निकट है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.B: उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा के लिए एक सींग ऊँचा किया है, जो उनके सब विश्वासयोग्य लोगों के लिए स्तुति का कारण है, अर्थात् इस्राएलियों के लिए, उस प्रजा के लिए जो उनके निकट है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!
hi.R: उन्होंने अपनी प्रजा को बलवान बनाया है। इससे उनके सब विश्वासयोग्य लोगों को स्तुति करने का कारण मिला है। वे इस्राएल के लोग हैं, वह प्रजा जो उनके निकट है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याह}} की स्तुति करो!

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вознёс рог для своего народа, хвалу для всех своих верных, для сынов Израиля, народа, близкого к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.B: Для своего народа {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вознёс рог, повод для хвалы всем своим верным, израильтянам, народу, близкому к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!
ru.R: Он сделал свой народ сильным. Это даёт всем {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} верным людям повод хвалить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Это израильтяне, народ, который близок к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}. Хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ях}}!

ja.L: その方は、ご自分の民のために角を高く上げてくださった。それは、ご自分のすべての誠実な者たちの賛美、イスラエルの子ら、ご自分の近くにいる民の[賛美]。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.B: その方は、ご自分の民のために角を高く上げてくださった。それは、ご自分に誠実なすべての人たち、ご自分の近くにいる民であるイスラエルの人々にとって、賛美となる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！
ja.R: その方は、ご自分の民を強くしてくださった。それで、ご自分に忠実なすべての人たちには、賛美する理由がある。彼らはイスラエルの人々、その方の近くにいる民だ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підняв ріг для свого народу, хвалу для всіх своїх вірних, для {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}}, народу, близького до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.B: Для свого власного народу {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підняв ріг, причину для хвали всім своїм вірним, ізраїльтянам, народові, близькому до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!
uk.R: Він зробив свій народ сильним. Це дає всім {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вірним людям причину хвалити. Це народ Ізраїля, народ, який близький до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яг}}!

decisions.choice: raised up a horn: given strength
decisions.reason: The horn of a wild ox was a picture of strength (89:18; 92:11; 1 Samuel 2:1). To raise a horn for a people is to make them strong. In 132:17 and 1 Samuel 2:10 the horn is linked with God's anointed king, so some read a king here.

decisions.choice: praise for all his faithful: a reason for them to praise
alternatives: he is the praise of all his faithful
decisions.reason: The word "praise" (tehillah) stands beside "a horn": what God has done is a cause of praise, or of honor, for his faithful people. It may also mean that God himself is the one they praise (Deuteronomy 10:21).

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

decisions.choice: a people near to him
decisions.reason: Israel is the people God has brought near to himself (Deuteronomy 4:7).

decisions.choice: He has made his people strong
alternatives: he has raised up a horn
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the horn means (m1).

decisions.choice: "enfants d'Israël" (Literal) and "Israélites" (Balanced) by default, with "fils d'Israël" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms set for "the sons of Israel", which means the whole people; the English has no setting here, but the French choice follows the book-wide form. Readable says "les Israélites", which is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "ቀንድን ከፍ አደረገ" (raised up a horn) at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The horn, a picture of strength (meaning decision m1), is kept as 1 Samuel 2:10 on main ("ቀንድ ከፍ ያደርጋል"); Readable says "made strong", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} (L); इस्राएली (B), इस्राएल के लोग (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Israel take the Pentateuch note's forms: a gender span at Literal, इस्राएली without a span at Balanced and Readable. The horn is सींग, as in 18:3 ("the horn of my salvation").

decisions.choice: сынов Израиля (L, no gender span); израильтянам (B, R)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has no gender span here ("the sons of Israel"), so the Russian Literal has none either and keeps "сынов Израиля", the phrase as a name for the nation; Balanced and Readable say "израильтяне", as the English says "the Israelites".

decisions.choice: вознёс рог
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of the horn, strength (m1); Readable says what it means, as the English does. "Свой", "своих" refer back to God as the subject and take no setting.

decisions.choice: vayyarem qeren "角を高く上げてくださった" (L, B), "強くしてくださった" (R); tehillah "賛美" (L), "賛美となる" (B), "賛美する理由がある" (R)
decisions.reason: qeren 角 (L, B), 力 (R) by the Psalter rule (PSA-1), here the strength given (m1, uncertain); praise for his faithful read as a reason for them to praise (m2, uncertain).

decisions.choice: chasidaw "ご自分の…誠実な者たち" (L), "ご自分に誠実な…人たち" (B), "ご自分に忠実な…人たち" (R); livnei Yisra'el "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Psalter chasid forms (PSA-1, PSA-2).

decisions.choice: hallelu-yah, one fixed form through Psalms 146-150: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ！" (L, B), "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美しよう！" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1, PSA-11): Yah is {{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}, the call 〜せよ (L, B), R 〜しよう since God's people are called; the closing Hallel takes the exclamation form used in 111-113 and 135, the same at the head and foot of every psalm.

decisions.choice: "нащадків Ізраїля" with "синів Ізраїля" as the alternative, as the shared terms note has it
decisions.reason: The English Literal has no span here, but the Ukrainian Old Testament gives the sons of Israel a gender span at Literal throughout.
